_doc: Hard caps in USD (plan §5). The gateway refuses any call whose pre-send estimate would cross the run cap or the global cap. S9 (2026-10-24): the Ultra arm of G3 (opencode + Nemotron 3 Ultra), corupta's request; the global cap is this ledger's $7.54 plus the new runs' caps, and the main ledger (budget/ledger.jsonl, $22.30) gets the spend carried over.
